newsitem.title: USA: GPU Inc says lawsuit without merit.
newsitem.headline: GPU Inc says lawsuit without merit.

text.p: GPU Inc said Wednesday that a breach of contract lawsuit naming one of its subsidiaries as a defendant was without merit and would be "vigorously defended."
The lawsuit, brought by Nestle Co against Freehold Cogeneration Associates, names Jersey Central Power & Light Co, the GPU subsidiary, as a defendant.
The lawsuit relates to the April 1996 agreement under which JCP&L agreed with Freehold Cogen to buy out the power purchase agreement for the proposed Freehold cogeneration project.

Nestle seeks damages of at least $75 million for Freehold Cogen's alleged breach of a steam sales agreement, and about $412 million in damages against JCP&L for its alleged unlawful interference with that agreement.
GPU said the complaint also requests an unspecified amount of punitive damages. The lawsuit was filed in New Jersey Superior Court.
